item.title: U18 GALLERY | Wrexham AFC vs Walsall FC

Jac Jones then got a second in the 88th minute as he weaved into the box and drove a low effort into the bottom corner. item.title: U18 PREVIEW | Blackpool FC vs Wrexham AFC
item.description: Wrexham AFC Under-18s are back on the road this week as they travel to take on Blackpool in the EFL Youth Alliance North, and they will look to maintain their unbeaten start to 2026. The young Red Dragons have secured victories over Shrewsbury Town, Morecambe, Southend United and Walsall in that time and played out a competitive 1-1 draw away at Oldham Athletic. The Lowdown: Blackpool The young Seasiders are currently sixth in the Youth Alliance North but have only been victorious once in 2026.

item.title: U18 REPORT | Blackpool FC 2-2 Wrexham AFC
item.description: Umar Nawaz's late goal secured Wrexham AFC Under-18s a 2-2 draw away at Blackpool to maintain their unbeaten start to 2026. It was the hosts who found the breakthrough as Billy Whaite converted from close range in the 16th minute, but just before half-time, Wes Graham restored parity for the young Red Dragons. Blackpool retook the lead in the 57th minute as Casey Bedford deflected it into his own net, but with just nine minutes remaining, Nawaz turned it home at the near post to secure a point.
